package.name: cyton_pose_commander
package.description: Drives the arm through a CSV list of tick-domain joint targets via MoveIt's MoveGroupInterface (plan+execute, collision-aware) instead of commanding raw ticks directly -- the "move" half of the MoveIt-driven NDI accuracy check, paired with cyton_ndi_capture's ndi_measure (the "measure" half, run separately/manually per pose). See CLAUDE.md's kinematic-calibration section for the origin of the tick data this reads and why tick-to-radian conversion must go through robot_calibration.cpp, not a reimplementation.
